source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Restores reward_unit_spend on 105 rules. The 09-Aug self-consistency pass flattened them to cashback_pct with a computed percentage, which rendered correctly but threw away the block size the issuer stated - and rewards accrue in whole blocks, not smoothly. Kotak's MITC: 'Points earned on transaction amounts in integer multiples of Rs.150. Transactions below Rs.150 or residual amounts will not earn points.' Lossless for display - (points/block) x point value x 100 is exactly what the flattened rate encoded, and all 105 re-render to the same percentage - but the engine can now round. Rs.1,000 of dining on IndianOil Kotak: 6 blocks of Rs.150, not 6.67.
